name: Fried one-sun mackerel
summary: Cá thu một nắng is fried crisp and eaten with rice when the table skips the seafood soups.
howToEat: Fried until crisp, with the rice. It sits beside canh rạm, not in the bowl.
where: The ordinary meal, and the Cái Dăm table. Not a named stall.
seoTitle: Ca thu mot nang ran — fried one-sun mackerel
seoDescription: Cá thu một nắng in Hạ Long is fried crisp and eaten with rice.
